q: What is the main weakness of ReWOO-style planning, which writes every tool call up front?
options: It needs more model calls than ReAct
It cannot change course when an early result should alter the plan
explain: Planning without observations saves calls but cannot react to surprises.

q: When does Reflexion-style self-critique help most?
options: When the critique is grounded in real feedback such as failing tests
When the model is asked to try harder
explain: Reflection without an external signal often just rephrases the same mistake.

q: Why does an externalized plan, such as a to-do file, still help reasoning models?
options: It survives compaction, crashes and handoffs, so the goal is not lost
explain: Thinking tokens disappear with the context; a written plan persists.
